name: Wrathful Vajra
summaryText: The purging flames burned a hundred times, yet never cleansed me.
descriptionText:
The Vajra with unquenchable rage — surely there's more to their cruelty than this. The warrior as steadfast as a mountain — surely there's more to their purity than this. The ascetic with a heart of flame — surely there's more to their suffering than this.

"The craftsman was really fixated on the design of the lion's head... He said all the anger and courage were hidden in those eyes."
—Banyue, who can't help but think the W-Engine looks a bit too much like himself.
